content: Flow with whatever may happen, and keep your mind free: Stay centered by accepting whatever you are doing. This is the ultimate.
author: Zhuangzi
sourceWork: The Book of Zhuangzi, Chapter 4 (In the Human World)
explanation: True peace does not come from controlling external circumstances, but from dissolving internal resistance. When the mind ceases arguing with reality and surrenders to the unfolding moment, friction vanishes.
practicalInsight: When encountering an unexpected detour or interruption today, immediately drop your resistance and lean into the new reality with curiosity.
reflectionPrompt: Where are you currently fighting reality rather than flowing with its natural current?
